name: NewFreeDAO reward contract repeatable claim
summary: The NFD reward contract's claim paid NFD in proportion to the caller's current NFD balance and recorded the claim only per address. The attacker bought NFD with flash-loaned WBNB, passed it through freshly created contracts that each claimed and handed it on, and dumped the accumulated NFD into the NFD/USDT pair.
notes: Loss is the USDT the NFD/USDT pair gave up to the dumped NFD over the three claim transactions; the claimed NFD itself is valued only through that sale. The attacker's later USDT-to-WBNB swaps were fair trades and are not victim depletion.

setInitLockTime (11 blocks after deployment) only opened the claim window; a replay with the old value reverts 'The collection time was not reached', a start gate rather than a reset. Single claims by holders after the crash (e.g. 0x57677411) used the contract as designed and are not counted.
